snippet.title: Casebook 1899 Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Casebook 1899 – The Leipzig Murders releases on September 4, 2025!

Step into the shoes of Detective Joseph Kreiser in a richly detailed point-and-click adventure set in 1899 Leipzig. Investigate four gripping cases, uncover hidden clues, and make choices that shape the outcome of each investigation. History, mystery, and murder await.

🕵️‍♂️ Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1841190/Casebook_1899__The_Leipzig_Murders/

🎮 Features:
– 4 criminal cases
– Hand-crafted pixel art
– Fully voiced in German, Text in German, English and Italian
– A serious, story-driven mystery steeped in turn-of-the-century German history

#Casebook1899 #IndieGame #PointAndClick #AdventureGame #DetectiveGame
